traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Gelsemiaceae: leaves opposite or whorled; leaves simple; margins dentate or entire; veins pinnate; stipules present or absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; joined corolla funnelform; stems woody; flowers in panicles or in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 4 to 5; stamens 4 to 5; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
